purpose: Diagnose repeat differences, not tune WER or create a new accuracy test.
selection: First two test clips in frozen comparison order: the same clips used by its repeat verifier. Retain every run, including failed inference.

changes.baseline: Current production CPU int8, 2 threads, no new environment overrides
changes.one_thread: Only Whisper CPU thread count is changed from 2 to 1
changes.seed_zero: Only CTranslate2 random seed is explicitly set to zero
changes.avx2_controlled: AVX2 dispatch, one Whisper/BLAS/OMP thread, MKL AVX2 reproducibility mode, MKL packed GEMM disabled; a combined control profile, not a single-factor cause claim

instrumentation: Production bounded PCM decoder and transcribe function imported unchanged; transparent model proxy records PCM, VAD-input, feature and encoder buffer hashes plus segment tokens. No reference text passed as prompt. Cold subprocess per inference.
policy: Preserve previous artifacts/scores and all diagnostic attempts. Do not replace active model or claim historical cause unless data localizes/supports it. Diagnostics on seen clips are not an independent ASR accuracy benchmark.
